covariate_profile_for_contrast: pooled typical profile (median continuous, modal categorical), mean depth fixed at 5 mmHg
interpretation: The estimated accumulation function has one effective degree of freedom, so the flexible model collapses to a linear duration effect: risk depends only on total hypotensive minutes and the 1x20 versus 4x5 contrast is null by construction.
covariate_independence: Under the linear functional specification the log-odds contrast between the two scenarios is sum_j h(d_j^A) - sum_j h(d_j^B), which does not involve the covariates. The log-odds contrast is therefore identical for every patient, and only the illustrative absolute risks depend on the profile at which they are evaluated.
